note: modifiers apply after rolling. chooseTwo races pick two different stats for +1 each. traits copy the doc text, including the text shared by all subraces. saveBonus applies to every save of that type; situational bonuses are shown as notes. bonusExperiences are added to the class count; bonusExperienceChoices are free picks.

races.name: Dwarf (Duergar)
traits: Dwarves have darkvision to 60 feet.
+2 on saves against poison and +2 on Magic Item saves against magic items.
Bonus Experience Stonecunning: things regarding slopes, new construction, stone traps, and gauging depth underground.
Gains Enlarge (self, 1/day) at 1st level and Invisibility (self, 1/day) at 5th.

races.name: Dragonborn
traits: Breath weapon: a 15-foot cone of fire, once per short or long rest, targets make a Blast/Barrage save. Damage scales with level, 2d6 at 1st-5th, 3d6 at 6th-10th, 4d6 at 11th-15th, 5d6 at 16th-20th.

races.name: Elf (Drow)
traits: Elves are immune to magical sleep and charm.
They are able to use Long Swords and Long Bows regardless of class.
They also have a passive chance to notice secret doors within a short distance, resolved as a roll under Wisdom.
Darkvision to 120 feet.
Light sensitivity imposes -2 on attack rolls and sight-based checks in bright light.
Innate spells: Dancing Lights at will from 1st level, Faerie Fire once per day from 3rd, Darkness once per day from 5th.

traits: Elves are immune to magical sleep and charm.

races.name: Firbolg
traits: Firbolg Magic grants Detect Magic and Disguise Self, each once per day from 1st level.
Powerful Build counts them as one size larger for carrying, pushing, and dragging.

races.name: Gnome (Deep)
traits: Gnomes have darkvision to 60 feet (120 for Deep Gnomes) and +2 on Spell saves against illusions.
Darkvision to 120 feet.
Non-Detection is constant and always active.

races.name: Gnome (Forest)
traits: Gnomes have darkvision to 60 feet (120 for Deep Gnomes) and +2 on Spell saves against illusions.
Speaks with small animals.

races.name: Gnome (Rock)
traits: Gnomes have darkvision to 60 feet (120 for Deep Gnomes) and +2 on Spell saves against illusions.
+2 on saves vs Magic Items and on Blast/Barrage saves against mechanical traps.

races.name: Goliath
traits: Mountain Born +2 saves vs Cold.
Gains bonus Experience in Mountain Survival.

races.name: Half-Elf
traits: +1 to any two ability scores.
+2 on Spell saves against sleep and charm.
Two Bonus Experiences.

races.name: Halfling (Lightfoot)
traits: +2 on saves against poison/fear, +2 on saves vs Magic Item.
Lucky: reroll a natural 1 on any attack roll, or saving throw. Reroll a natural 20 on any ability check

races.name: Halfling (Stout)
traits: +2 on saves against poison/fear, +2 on saves vs Magic Item.
They gain +2 on saves against poison.

races.name: Human
traits: +1 to any two ability scores, plus one bonus Experience.
+20% experience points gained

races.name: Tiefling
traits: Darkvision to 60 feet and +2 to saves vs fire.
